title: Outcomes-tracking process (partner self-report; no client telemetry) + reuser register
context: food-assistance-maps collects no recipient telemetry — reach is measured exclusively through partner self-report and downstream-reuser reports. This is an explicit privacy/measurement trade-off: the dataset serves vulnerable people who must not be tracked. The outcomes-tracking process must be privacy-preserving by design, with a standard reporting template that partners can fill in without collecting or sharing any client PII. Depends on food-maps-partner-016 (a named partner who can report).
objective: Design and document a privacy-preserving outcomes-tracking process using partner self-report: (1) a standard reporting template (partner, period, channels, confirmed successful referrals/look-ups, flagged estimates, regions/languages, de-dup notes) over a rolling 12-month window; (2) a counting rule (distinct people per reporting period, de-duplicated across partners at roll-up); (3) a reuser register tracking downstream integrations; and (4) a process for collecting and aggregating reports without any client PII.
acceptanceCriteria: Standard partner self-report template defined with fields: partner name, reporting period, channels used, confirmed successful referrals/look-ups (count), estimated reach (labeled as estimate), regions covered, languages served, de-duplication notes
Template explicitly states: no client PII collected — counts only, no names, IDs, addresses, or demographics
Counting rule documented: each partner counts a person once per reporting period across their touchpoints; de-duplication across partners is best-effort at roll-up, partner-attested
Rolling 12-month window defined; aggregated counts are recorded separately from estimates
Reuser register template defined: reuser name/org, type of integration (211 import, community map, app, etc.), region, date of integration, contact
Process for collecting reports documented (cadence, submission method, aggregation and publication)
Process reviewed by the steward and at least one partner representative before finalization
The template and process are published in the repo so any partner or downstream reuser can use them
output: docs/outcomes-tracking.md (process document + partner report template + reuser register template).
